writing_guide: Every question comes from Procedure 401.4-KC, the Kansas City Medication List by Level (draft 09/29/2026, from the 2027 Protocols, pending Medical Director approval). If the list and the protocols differ, the protocols govern.
Name drugs the way a nurse says them on the phone: the brand, with the generic in brackets.
Prompts and statements 12 words or fewer; explanations two sentences or fewer.

fluids.name: Fluids & Antibiotics
fluids.tip: Crystalloids, dextrose, potassium on a pump and antibiotics are AEMT. Hypertonic saline, colloids, TPN, blood and antifungals aren't.

comfort.name: Pain, Calm & Comfort
comfort.tip: Opioid and benzo drips and PCAs are AEMT only if the patient isn't intubated or sedated.

als.name: Paramedic Only
als.tip: Pressors, BP and rate drips, heparin, insulin, sedation, Pitocin, Pepcid, Protonix, Keppra, IV Tylenol: Paramedic.

rules.name: Read the Whole List
rules.tip: One drug off the AEMT list, or on neither list, makes the call Paramedic.
